description: The official Mass Mobilization baseline, dataset version, and eligibility decisions for these candidates remain pending coordinator verification; this dossier makes no official update.
required_followup: Coordinator to verify the official baseline and source procedure before any consolidation or eligibility decision.

description: Open-web discovery is not the original LexisNexis method. Eight captured batched calls contain 31 query clauses and 237 returned URL/header entries, but no systematic licensed-archive search was available; results are not an event census.
required_followup: Use authorized systematic archives and continue source discovery while retaining the method and archive limits.

description: Caibarién reports use several dozen or dozens for gatherings around a fined seller and at a municipal office. Neither opened account provides a numeric total or proves at least 50 actual demonstrators.
required_followup: Find a reliable actual attendance estimate for each location; keep witness, bystander, and demonstrator counts distinct.

description: The opened Caibarién reports differ by one day and describe activity at the seller and municipal office. Whether the latter was a continuation, a separate assembly, or a report-date discrepancy is unresolved.
required_followup: Verify the exact physical date and sequence using original video, dated reporting, or a direct report; do not assign the later office gathering as the first day without evidence.

description: ADN Cuba reports that the fine was removed after the February 28 municipal-office action. The outcome must not be transferred to the February 27 seller-side gathering unless the two boundaries are established as one episode. The article credits Yolanda Huerga at Radio Televisión Martí without identifying the specific originating story URL.
required_followup: Verify the outcome and recover the specific Radio Televisión Martí or other originating account; preserve the distinction between direct and retrospective reporting.

description: For the Camagüey leaflet episode, the report gives an approximate number arrested and says queue members objected, but no total attendance or participating-bystander count.
required_followup: Locate an actual participant estimate and determine whether bystanders joined; do not substitute the queue size or arrests for turnout.

description: The exact Camagüey leaflet text is not reproduced in the opened report. The story associates the action with long queues and a slogan, but an explicit demand directed at Cuban government behavior or policy is not established.
required_followup: Recover the leaflets or a direct organizer account, then decide whether a named demand category and state target are supported.

description: The opened Camagüey report dates leafleting to February 27; other search-only records describe a February 28 demonstration, queue protest, or arrests. It is unresolved whether these are variants of one episode or separate actions.
required_followup: Read permitted contemporaneous source bodies under the fresh-receipt workflow and compare exact locations, actors, timing, and originating links before merging or splitting.

description: Neither candidate has a verified physical end date or body-read evidence establishing a pre-month or post-month continuation. Search-only references and monthly totals do not establish continuity or closure.
required_followup: Seek event-specific dated accounts before and after the reported actions; retain null end dates and do not equate later reporting with continued assembly.

description: The 14ymedio March 5 edition PDF contains a search-result lead about Caibarién, but the reader returned a one-line tool error and a separately gated ordinary request failed DNS before HTTP. No publisher denial or article body was observed.
required_followup: Retry only under a new gate if permitted; otherwise retain the PDF as search-only and do not use its snippet as event evidence.

description: Some Caibarién reports cite unnamed witnesses, social-network videos, or a later Radio Televisión Martí credit; the originating media and independence among search-only accounts are not established. CiberCuba also references user posts and videos without independent authentication.
required_followup: Recover documented original links where allowed and map syndication or shared-origin relationships without inferring them from topic or byline.

description: Searches included generic and weekly Spanish/English queries and episode-specific terms, but Cuba's regional press, non-Spanish-language reporting, radio archives, and official or rights-organization incident records were not searched systematically.
required_followup: Extend discovery with authorized regional, official, international, and human-rights archives; distinguish no located account from no event.
